about: The rows of the bit-parity coverage board (build_parity_board.py): every module of the three kernel tables' step lists, and the array-path families judged against MEEP. Structure only; no entry is a verdict.

source.step_lists: results/bit_parity_0_10/design/KERNELS.md section 8, with DESIGN.md D27's moves. Section 8 names two groups by count; they are enumerated from design/checks/critique_kernels/step_coverage_{cuda,metal}.log: CUDA C9's 'other 8 nopml modules', Metal M12's '13 none(plain-form) modules', and the 9 Metal host modules D27 assigns to KM0.
source.kinds: host: steps C0, T0, M0 (no device form); a_only: C9, T10, M12 and CUDA complex_no_pml_kernels (no absorber, so no B select); unchanged: the CUDA modules section 8 lists as unchanged; kernel: every other row.
source.families: results/bit_parity_0_10/DESIGN.md section 2.5 (the families, their phase-0 tokens and work packages); the base row is WPs AP3-AP5 and the mirror-symmetry row is AP4's ghost rule (D5).
